# Automotive Market Data

## Recommended context sources

- [FCAI VFACTS publications](https://www.fcai.com.au/news/index/view/news/770)
- [Australian Bureau of Statistics](https://www.abs.gov.au/statistics)
- [ABS Data by Region](https://www.abs.gov.au/statistics/people/people-and-communities/regional-statistics/latest-release)
- [Google Trends](https://trends.google.com/trends/)
- [data.gov.au](https://data.gov.au/data)

## Use

Use for aggregate market context, regional context and search-interest discussion. Do not use public context data as a replacement for first-party web or CRM conversion data.
